text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David. A Song.
Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion; and to you shall vows be performed,
text_cn: 天主，人应在熙雍山上歌咏赞美你， 同时也应向你还愿，因你允我所祈。

text_en: O you who answer prayer! To you all flesh shall come.
text_cn: 凡一切有血肉的人们， 都因罪过，而向你投奔。

text_en: When deeds of iniquity overwhelm us, you forgive our transgressions.
text_cn: 我们的罪重压着我们， 但你都一一赦免不存。

text_en: Happy are those whom you choose and bring near to live in your courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
text_cn: 你所选拔，而使他居留在你庭院的人，真是有福！ 愿我们得饱享你居所的福乐，你殿宇中的圣物！

text_en: By awesome deeds you answer us with deliverance, O God of our salvation; you are the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
text_cn: 天主我们的救主你常照公义以奇事来俯听我们， 世人在天涯地角与海洋的远处都对你全心信任。

text_en: By your strength you established the mountains; you are girded with might.
text_cn: 你以神威大能束腰， 你以大力坚定山岳；

text_en: You silence the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the tumult of the peoples.
text_cn: 你曾平息了澎湃的汪洋， 咆哮的巨浪，万民的喧嚷：

text_en: Those who live at earth’s farthest bounds are awed by your signs; you make the gateways of the morning and the evening shout for joy.
text_cn: 远居地角的人，因你的奇迹而恐慌； 你使东西两极的人，都要喜气洋洋。

text_en: You visit the earth and water it, you greatly enrich it; the river of God is full of water; you provide the people with grain, for so you have prepared it.
text_cn: 你眷顾大地，普降甘霖，使大地丰收； 天主的河水洋溢，为他们准备五谷。 原来这一切都是由于你安排就绪。

text_en: You water its furrows abundantly, settling its ridges, softening it with showers, and blessing its growth.
text_cn: 你灌溉了田畦，又犁平了土壤， 使雨松软土壤，祝福植物生长。

text_en: You crown the year with your bounty; your wagon tracks overflow with richness.
text_cn: 你的慈惠使年岁丰收， 你的脚步常滴流脂油。

text_en: The pastures of the wilderness overflow, the hills gird themselves with joy,
text_cn: 旷野的牧场丰满外溢， 漫山遍陵充满了欢喜；

text_en: the meadows clothe themselves with flocks, the valleys deck themselves with grain, they shout and sing together for joy.
text_cn: 羊群遮蔽了牧场， 山谷盖满了食粮， 一切在欢呼歌唱。
